title: Unsafe referrer policy (html) — review required
description: A page sets the most permissive referrer policy: referrerpolicys*=s*["']unsafe-url. Full URLs — including tokens and ids in query strings — leak to every linked site. This lexical rule flags the policy; the reviewer confirms no sensitive query data or tightens it.
remediation: Set strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter so cross-origin links carry no full URL.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the policy regardless of URL sensitivity.
